Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

actisensorlog 0.3.0

CRAN release: 2026-10-22

  • The SensorLog/SensorLogger readers and helpers from ‘actiread’ (acti_read_sensorlog(), acti_read_sensorlogger(), …) are now true re-exports documented in ?reexports, so their arguments always match the installed ‘actiread’ (which renames file to path).
  • Requires ‘actibase’ (>= 0.8.0) for acti_standardize_epoch().
  • ‘purrr’ and ‘readr’ are no longer imported; they were unused.
  • acti_minute_sensorlog(seconds = ) accepts epoch strings such as "1 min", and summaries longer than 60 seconds no longer error.
  • acti_process_sensorlog() and acti_sensorlog_process_time() now default to verbose = TRUE.

actisensorlog 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-09-12

  • Initial CRAN submission.
  • Removing magrittr dependency.
